terms_intro: By booking a rental with Apex Electric, you agree to the following terms as defined in our current fleet operations policy :
term_bullet_1: Renters must be at least 20 years of age and hold a valid, unrestricted driver's license.
term_bullet_2: A valid license must be presented in person at the time of the vehicle pick up.
term_bullet_3: Apex Electric reserves the right to cancel or reschedule bookings due to adverse weather or vehicle availability.
term_bullet_4: Renters agree to follow all instructions provided by the Apex Electric Specialist during the drive.
term_bullet_5: Liability coverage is provided during the rental period, subject to local regulations and policy limitations.
terms_footer_note: Note: These terms are subject to change and were last updated on February 24, 2026.
